This matters a great deal: the URJC title is RUCT 4316273 with estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN A EXTINGUIR)' — a title being WOUND DOWN, which per the shared brief may not accept a 2027 intake at all — whereas the UCJC title (4312968) is 'TITULACIÓN RENOVADA' and healthy. The calendars being on UCJC's own Blackboard is the strongest evidence that what is actually taught is the UCJC title, but the discrepancy is unresolved and MUST be put to ISEMCO before anyone applies. (4) FIT IS TANGENTIAL to the music path: this is corporate/institutional protocol and events, and touches live music only in passing ('eventos culturales como festivales de música').

Universidad Camilo José Cela)' i.e. a university's own certificate, not a máster universitario. It is NOT in RUCT under this name (checked against output/ruct-backbone.jsonl, which lists 17 registered events masters, none with this title). No PhD access, no MECES level, normally ineligible for public postgraduate scholarships.

modality: Semipresencial — 'Su modalidad es semipresencial con 14 módulos. Las sesiones presenciales duran 10 horas distribuidas en fines de semana alternos (viernes de 16.00 h. a 21.00 h. y sábado de 9.30 h. a 14.30 h.)'
language_of_instruction: Español (inferred from the page; no explicit declaration found)

El resto, hasta en 9 cuotas (de septiembre de 2026 a mayo de 2027). Pago único: 3% de descuento'. A 750 EUR early-reservation discount applies before 31 August 2026.
evidence_verbatim: 'comenzando en octubre y finalizando en junio'; '60 CRÉDITOS'; 'Prácticas externas 6 / Trabajo fin de Máster 6'; 'El mundo del espectáculo en vivo, los festivales y los eventos culturales se ha diversificado mucho en los últimos años, exigiendo una formación específica de los profesionales que se encargan de ellos.'
notes: NEGATIVE on spring, but recorded because it is BY SOME MARGIN THE BEST CONTENT FIT IN THIS SLICE FOR PATH S — it is explicitly about live entertainment, festivals and cultural events ('espectáculo en vivo, los festivales y los eventos culturales'), unlike ISEMCO's official protocol masters which are corporate/institutional. 60 ECTS with 6 ECTS of external placements and a 6-ECTS TFM, and it is one of only two programmes in this whole slice that publishes a real price. ⚠️ Two problems for this candidate: it is a TÍTULO PROPIO (no PhD access, no public funding), and its semipresencial format is alternate weekends only — roughly 120 contact hours across the year — which is very unlikely to satisfy the full-time-study test for a Spanish student visa. Single October start, so it offers no early-start route.
